2024_188_feb_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for February 2024, carried in the Board of Education materials for the April 16, 2024 meeting, is a flat register of every card transaction posted under the journal-entry description FEB 2024 PCARD EXP, with posting dates running from 1/26/2024 through 2/26/2024. Each row lists a truncated merchant name, a fifteen-digit budget unit, a four-digit account code, a transaction amount and a credit amount. The printout is dated 4/11/2024 and runs 41 pages. It closes with a Subtotal of 354,273.12 in charges and 11,858.26 in credits, and Total Expenses of 342,414.86.
